question: Does static-v2 capture_order_value, isolated from leaf value and the fixed foe, improve finite-budget outcomes or reduce actual node cost on fresh generated 5x5 roots?
changed_premise: A complete no-outcome preflight on eight newly generated rules and 16 prescheduled 3/4-ply roots observed the public default MoveOrderer capture hook 84 times on roots, changed production order in 12 roots, and changed five root search choices; the actual search made 4,209 Unit and 4,243 static capture-order calls with no type_value calls. This is exposure evidence only, not a utility claim.

roots.selection: Use every root in the hash-bound outcome-free preflight; no action, outcome, hook-count, or profile-based filtering or replacement.

arms.physical_games: 8 rules x 2 roots x 2 candidate owners x 2 candidate arms = 64
arms.fixed_foe: Unit leaf and Unit capture-order values in both arms; same public AlphaBeta path and limits.
arms.candidate_only_change: Controlled evaluator has identical Unit board/hand leaf and type_value behavior in both candidate arms; only capture_order_value changes from Unit board table to current rule-derived static profile board table. Production MoveOrderer remains default; staged picker remains off.

analysis.primary: Pair static-minus-Unit candidate reward by exact generated root and candidate owner against the same fixed Unit foe. Each UNKNOWN independently contributes [-1,+1] before conservative subtraction.
analysis.robustness: Report all-slot bounds overall, by candidate owner, 3/4-ply root parity and leave-one-rule-seed-out; preserve candidate-first/reply and each seed. No winner/draw imputation.
analysis.cost: Report actual completed depth, candidate and foe nodes/qnodes/caller seconds, fallback/source, and paired candidate node deltas. Treat wall-clock as descriptive only under concurrent load.
analysis.retain_rule: Retain this sampled-scope ordering candidate only if either (a) conservative utility lower bounds are strictly positive overall, by owner, by root parity and for every leave-one-seed-out view, or (b) median paired candidate-node use falls by at least 10% overall and in both owner and parity strata, while no corresponding stratum has a negative conservative utility lower bound. Otherwise close this capture-order route for this sample. Neither outcome changes a default/global value or strength claim.

integrity: Use all 64 slots; no outcome-based filtering, top-up, replacement, cap extension or rerun of an observed slot.
Preserve promotions, drops, hands, auxiliary state, repetition and complete Core history; validate action legality and full replay.
Retain UNKNOWN for horizon or unresolved search; report actual terminals, cancellations, fallbacks and incomplete slots distinctly.
No training, solver, production-source changes or other-role checkout access.

The expected run is under 10 minutes based on prior same-scale 64-game public-AlphaBeta work; conservative estimate 10 minutes, hard cap 60 minutes. It is <120 minutes and does not require a necessity assessment.

cost.cheaper_alternative: Stop after the no-outcome exposure audit and leave capture-order utility unresolved.
cost.basis: Previous 64-game D3/4096 panel took 282.66 seconds; current D3/8192 and full replay estimated conservatively at 600 seconds; 3600-second frozen cap.
